blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – Final Four playoff MANILA, Philippines—University of the Philippines clinched the top seed after defeating National University, 77-67, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum on Saturday. The Fighting Maroons broke from a tie with the Bulldogs and captured the first twice-to-beat advantage in the Final Four after improving to a league-best 10-4 record at the end of the elimination round.
